interfaces.battery.run: run(spec, builds, traces, seeds, mode, level, explain=None, families=None, root=None) -> {ran, runs, summary, applicable_families, guess, b5a_discordant_failure_share, protect_live, load_bearing, rates, lint, harness_errors, notes, tier, cpu_s}
interfaces.battery.mustpass: mustpass(spec, builds, traces, seeds, mode, level, prechecked=None, root=None) -> {ran, runs, summary: {applicable, realised, passed, failed_unexempt, failed, unrealised, capped, budget}, harness_errors}
interfaces.battery.audit: audit(spec, n=200, builds=None) -> audits.audit record (cached per spec hash and n)
interfaces.battery.private: private(spec, references, seeds, mode, level, salt=None, key=None, pool=None) -> {ran, results, runs, mustpass_runs, details, harness_errors}
interfaces.battery.heldout_rates: heldout_rates(spec, builds, traces, seeds, mode, level) -> run() restricted to B4, B5, B7, B8

deviations.what: skill-level generation throughout: retargets rebind the reference plan, B8 cross runs the other variant's plan with this seed's bindings, concrete commands moved to another layout are lifted to skills (fetch / put / use / approach)
deviations.why: replayed concrete footsteps were refused in another layout and made most of these runs unrealised battery debt; B5a keeps A's ids, values and waits (open loop)

deviations.what: B6 undo_last undoes the last command a success label reads; undo_all is checked against the values before the earliest undone command
deviations.why: undoing put(close=True)'s cabinet door failed a correct spec on house.changed alone (fails_other)

deviations.what: B11 is one rate record per decision role; its blind picks, B12's pre-checks and a breadth-first sub-policy's later seeds are recorded as skipped:tier (not counted)
deviations.why: their requirement is the rate, the load-bearing test or the already reported pass

deviations.what: B5c's best constant and B7's fixed-timer exposure are battery records (B5.c-share, B7.exposure) at the full level; entity constants by rank in the group
deviations.why: they are those families' requirements (10.3); ids differ between houses

deviations.what: forking only when the reference prefix costs at least 0.6 CPU-s; snapshots in the system temp folder (or HOUSE_SIM_FORK_CACHE), not reports/cache/forks/
deviations.why: a snapshot costs 0.07 s + 0.27 s and 4 MB; the project folder is OneDrive-synced

deviations.what: the decided-early stop is checked at D, the fast-forward equivalence check replays the reference only
deviations.why: the saving is settle and look-ahead; the idle half is the verifier's fine-tick idle rollout

deviations.what: P7's confirming runs use V's seeds and the private pool is derived from the salt (test candidates skipped only with key=)
deviations.why: battery.private receives V's references and the salt only (request to WP5)

deviations.what: PM's runs are reported as mustpass_runs, not runs
deviations.why: a must-pass pass is met; in private_battery it would fail G3

deviations.why: the kernel has no damaging-verb registry (plugins.py is WP1's); handles are issued at run time, not at setup
